## Recovered observations

21 points (from FB-5) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appb-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Printed o.84 with a letter o for the zero. Dense specimen vibrated with a small vibrating plate (text 2). Markers about 1.8 to 9.4 psi. One specimen per printed Dr assumed (text 2: several measurements on each sample at different confining pressures); paired markers at one pressure may be repeat shots. E = ρc² with no Poisson correction; mass density and specimen size not printed.
- Codex: Density group with repeated stress-wave measurements; E = ρc²; no Poisson correction. Specimen dimensions and pulse duration missing. Leading o retained as printed; ID uses 0.84. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. 5, printed 8, PDF 111
